title: Dashboard Foundation
description: Bootstraps the app shell, routing, API layer, auth, and global elements. Must ship first — blocks all other epics.
architectureNotes: React 18 + Vite + TypeScript + TailwindCSS. React Query for data fetching. Zustand for auth/UI state. React Router 7 with lazy loading. WebSocket at /api/v1/stream. Existing UI primitives: Button, Card, Badge, Drawer, Input, Select, Textarea, MetricCard, ProgressBar, StatusBadge, AppShell.
epicRails: All new files go under dashboard/src/
Use existing UI primitives from dashboard/src/components/ui/
Use React Query for all server state
Use Zustand only for client-side state (auth, UI prefs, WS events)
